jobs.description:
As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using ROS2

• Integrate and optimize navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion

• Build perception systems using Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization)

• Design and deploy Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decision-making

• Work hands-on with real robots: system integration, deployment, tuning, and performance optimization

• Contribute to robot control, localization, and path planning

• Participate in on-site testing and customer deployments across Belgium and the Netherlands

• You are hands-on and have at least 3 to 5 years of experience and strong affinity with autonomous navigation, robotics, machine control or industrial automation

• You have a thorough knowledge of ROS2, C, C++, and Python

• Solid knowledge in majority of the following fields:Sensor fusion for state estimation and localization

• Control systems for robotics

• Path planning & Navigation (SLAM)

• Computer Vision and Machine Learning applied to robotics

• You are comfortable working with hardware and in real-world field environments and experience bringing systems from prototype to reliable field deployment

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your work

• You have a valid EU driving license (for site testing and deployments)

• You can communicate fluently in English

For an international company in the port of Zeebrugge, we are seeking 100% EV Car Technicians.

In this role, you will be responsible for troubleshooting, vehicle diagnostics, repairs, quality inspections, software updates, and more.

You have a very good knowledge of English (spoken/written).

You have a technical background in automotive (Level 3 EV certification + working experience).

You are IT literate, with capability to surf through different working tools, reporting systems, diagnostic tool, etc.​

You are communicative as you'll have to update colleagues (technical & non-technical) on the status of the vehicles.

You work organized as you will have to create reports to show results of the performed activities.

Are you a handy jack-of-all-rounder with a passion for maintenance? Then I’m looking for you!

For a company in Aalter that specializes in structural steel, I’m looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician!

What will your responsibilities be?

• You’ll perform preventive and corrective maintenance on pneumatic, mechanical, and hydraulic systems.
• You’ll thoroughly troubleshoot and resolve malfunctions in machines and systems.
• You’ll work in a technical team where everyone is committed to optimization.
• You’ll strictly adhere to safety regulations.
• You’ll conduct quality checks.

Who are you?

• You have a technical mindset! This is reflected in your experience or technical training.
• You preferably have knowledge of pneumatic, hydraulic, and/or mechanical systems.
• You have experience with preventive maintenance.
• You are passionate about troubleshooting and resolving issues.
• You speak English or Dutch.
• Polish or Romanian is a plus!

A highly reliable partner for our customers around the world, we offer environmentally friendly products that increase the comfort of homes and buildings in terms of insulation, safety, acoustics and air quality.

Remuneration: 17.5605 / h + shiftnumération : 2 shifts: 1.2497 /h + 4.5 euro meal vouchers per day worked.

As an operator in the recycling department, you and your colleagues will be responsible for the following tasks:

- supply and removal of materials by forklift truck

- filling the goods

- cleaning the production lines

 

You have had technical training or already have experience working within production.

You can work on a regular 2 shifts: 6h-14h, 14h-22h or fix night shift 22h-6h

You communicate in English

You can work with a PC.

You can work with a forklift truck. A certificate can be obtained through us.

Safe and clean work is important to you

We are looking for an additional production worker within the cladding department.

Salary: 17.912 euro bruto / hour + 1.2497 euro bruto/ hour extra shiftpremie or 4.16556 euro bruto/ hour in de fix night + 4.5 euro mealvouchers per day.

Duties:

- You are responsible for inserting and removing the profiles in the machine.

- You assist the operator in a smooth start-up of the production line and support him/her when the process needs to be adjusted.

- Together with the operator you monitor the continuity and quality of the process and follow up on the operator's instructions.

You have had your first experience in production.

You can hold an interview in English.

You can work in 2 shifts or nightshift

For an automotive company in Zeebrugge, we are looking for a full-time category B Driver for the 'YARD' department. You will work in a two-shift system.

What does the job entail?

As a Yard Driver / operator, you and your colleagues ensure that port terminal logistics run smoothly and without interruptions.

Main responsibilities:

• Shunting: Safely and efficiently maneuvering and moving vehicles from point A to point B across the yard / terminal grounds.
• Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI): Carrying out final quality checks before vehicles are dispatched to clients.
• Damage inspection: Checking incoming vehicles at the terminal for any existing damage.
• Periodic maintenance checks: Performing checks such as battery health checks and engine runs.

VG 458/BUOSAP

• driver's license: You have held a valid Category B driver's license for at least 2 years.
• language skills: Very good command (speaking and understanding) of either Dutch or English.
• work ethic: Reliable, punctual, and committed to working with precision and care.
• availability: Available full-time to work in a 2-shift rotation (06:30 - 14:15 / 14:30 - 22:15).
As a yard driver / Operator, you and your colleagues ensure that port terminal logistics run smoothly and without interruptions.

Your future job

You’ll also be responsible for maintenance tasks and cleaning the equipment, ensuring everything runs safely and smoothly.

In short: a varied role where you play an important part in keeping the production process efficient and well-organized!

You speak good English and can communicate easily on the work floor.

You’re not afraid of physical work and like to get things done.

You don’t mind getting your hands dirty.

You’re motivated to work in a 6-shift system.

We are looking for an experienced Forklift Driver for a company specialized in the construction and interior sector. 

What are your tasks? 

• Responsibility of operating the line
• Safely but quickly move goods on and off trucks using a forklift
• Place items in the correct storage locations and stack them securely
• Move pallets and products between the dock, warehouse, and storage areas
• Respect safety rules, wear protective equipment, and ensure a safe working environment

What do we expect from you? 

• You are a motivated candidate who is ready to pick up their new tasks quickly
• You have broad experience as a forklift driver
• You are in possession of a forklift certificate
• You have your own car
• You speak English well
• You are aware of the importance of following health and safety guidelines

• Identifying and resolving irregularities and malfunctions in the logistics flows. 
• Carrying out minor technical interventions to ensure a safe and smooth flow of goods. 
• Working with modern systems and operating cranes and shuttles in the automated cold storage facility. 
• Interpreting data trends and reporting process information with the aim of contributing to improvement actions for the logistics department.

In our kitchen, we produce preparations that would make grandmothers jealous, but on an industrial scale and in large quantities.

We are looking for a Cook in the Aalter region! 
What are your responsibilities? 
• Hygiene is essential for any kitchen employee. That is why you ensure every day that your working methods and finished products comply with all applicable standards.
• You strictly follow all safety regulations. You do everything possible to guarantee both quality and safety. 

Who are you?
• You have experience as a cook in a large-scale catering kitchen or an industrial kitchen. Experience in a production environment is a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system. 
• The early shift starts at 4:30 AM and ends at 12:30 PM.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 PM and ends at 8:00 PM. 
• Team player – You are friendly, enthusiastic, and enjoy working with others. Helping colleagues comes naturally to you.

• Flexible – You like working as part of a team but can also work independently. In addition, you enjoy the variety of working with different products and tasks.
• Communicative – You have good communication skills and a good command of Dutch and/or English.

Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety.    

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.

• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.

Aluvision is a fast-growing international company and a market leader in innovative modular exhibition systems for exhibits & events, retail, and interior design. Our high-quality, sustainable solutions are trusted by global brands and partners to create impactful and flexible environments.
 

To support our continued growth, we are expanding our presence in Italy and are looking for a driven 
Sales Manager Italy to accelerate our commercial success in this key market.
 

As Sales Manager Italy, you grow our customer portfolio through active prospecting and lasting partnerships. You combine commercial drive with technical understanding to advise customers. You report directly to the Sales Director.

 

•  

A professional sales experience of minimum 5 years
  

•  

Experience in B2B sales, business development, field sales or account management, with success in acquiring new customers.
  

•  

A proactive hunter mentality, strong communication and negotiation skills, and an independent, structured approach.
  

•  

Technical understanding and solution-oriented selling skills; experience in exhibitions, events or display systems is a plus.
  

•  

Fluent Italian, a good command of English, and commercial or technical education or equivalent experience.
  

•  

Willingness to travel across Italy for approximately 60% of your working time.

jobs.occupation: Recruitment Consultant I Open to Graduates & Junior Profiles
jobs.description:
As a Recruitment Consultant, you will help companies identify their future talent while supporting candidates throughout their career journeys. It's a dynamic, entrepreneurial and people-focused role where no two days are the same.

Client Details

You will be joining the newest division of a global player in the field of recruitment, which has also won the Top Employer award several times in a row.

Description

• Attend presentations and meetings
• Approach a network of customers and candidates
• Persuade them to work with you on their recruitment needs
• Negotiate terms, brief them and advise them on their recruitment needs
• Manage the entire recruitment cycle, from candidate selection to offer management
• Participate in job fairs and universities
 

• You speak Dutch and/or French fluently and have an excellent level of English
• You are a driven, social and entrepreneurial person
• You can work autonomously while remaining a real team-player
• You are a persuasive and compelling person able to sell yourself and the company
• You are adaptable and can change your style of delivery depending on your audience
